mapper.sql: c.publication_status = 'PUBLISHED' and c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and c.admission_status = 'PASSED' and c.is_duplicate = false and c.fact_status <> 'DEBUNKED' and c.provider_name is not null and lower(c.provider_name) not in ('mock', 'test', 'fixture')
mapper.select: select c.id, s.name as source_name, c.source_type, c.source_official_level, c.content_type, coalesce(c.title_zh, c.original_title) as title, c.original_title, c.summary_zh as summary, c.recommendation_reason, c.original_url, c.canonical_url, c.fact_status, c.final_score, c.featured, c.source_published_at, c.effective_published_at as published_at from content.content_item c join source.source_entity s on s.id = c.source_entity_id where c.id = #{id} and
